_: THE CLOSED LIST of audit actions of SecurityInsight Pro (#260, framework AUDIT-1.1). Read by BOTH writers: the web app (SI.Management.Web Audit/AuditActions.cs, linked into the build) and PowerShell (engine/pro-settings/SI-Audit.ps1, Write-SIAuditEvent). A test compares the two lists, a test checks every [Audit] handler names an action listed here, and a test checks the trigger's category CASE in sql/si-pro-settings.sql against changeCategories. An action is lower-case domain.object.verb. Adding one = one entry here; renaming one breaks the history of the old name -- add, never rename.

actions.what: a role / scope assignment created or changed (Configuration > Access (roles + scopes))
a role / scope assignment removed (Configuration > Access (roles + scopes))
the audit trail exported (CSV or Excel) -- the filter and the row count
the audit trail's print view opened (evidence)
audit rows older than the retention removed by the data sync's retention step
staged changes committed (Review & commit) -- each change also has its change row
staged changes discarded (Review & commit)
the vulnerability close-loop applied one connector's plan (opened / reopened / closed / errors)
the vulnerability close-loop moved one record to its asset's current id, or retired it as a duplicate of the record that keeps the finding (never as fixed)
a commit undone (framework CONFIG-1.2): the inverse of the chosen records committed through Review & commit, journaled with Source undo and the commit it reverses
the inverse of a commit staged for Review & commit (Operations > Commits (undo)); nothing is written until it is committed
a configuration backup taken: by the daily backup job or Back up now -- a copy, or 'no change' recorded without a copy
configuration backups older than the retention removed by the backup job (pinned ones and content a kept backup points at stay)
a configuration backup pinned (kept past the retention) or unpinned
a configuration backup downloaded as a signed file
a configuration backup file imported as a backup (its signature verified, or accepted unverified by an explicit tick)
records restored from a configuration backup (framework CONFIG-1.4): chosen per record, staged, committed through Review & commit with Source restore
records chosen from a backup staged for Review & commit (or sent to a second SuperAdmin); nothing is written until committed
a guard release or a restore asked of a second SuperAdmin (framework CONFIG-1.5, setting SIWeb_ConfigSecondPerson)
a second SuperAdmin approved or rejected a guard release or a restore asked by someone else
change journal rows older than SI_Pro_ConfigJournalRetentionDays removed (never shorter than the backup retention)
the configuration exported to a signed file (framework CONFIG-IO-1): all of it or the chosen sections -- never a secret value
a configuration file uploaded on Export / Import and compared with the configuration now (signature, version and tenant checked); nothing is written
the chosen items of an uploaded configuration file previewed (WhatIf): what Apply would stage; nothing is written
the chosen items of an uploaded configuration file staged for Review & commit (or sent to a second SuperAdmin), the file kept as a backup
an earlier collection sent again into a connector by hand (the request, and the job that ran it through the connector's normal path and guards)
the last run of a connector undone where the connector can reverse it (the request, and the job that put the items back)

a business service changed
a business service retired
an external CMDB CSV uploaded as the new snapshot
a v2.2 CMDB.csv migrated into the SecurityInsight CMDB
a service-map link change staged

a retired or no-longer-seen asset was seen again and is active again (#406); its findings reopen
an Admin retired an asset SecurityInsight no longer sees before its grace period ended (Assets & services > CMDB > Not seen anymore, #406)

a job applied a released held set: the vulnerability connector's closes (how many closed, how many came back and stayed open), or the data sync loading a released Risk Analysis collection once, marked partial
